ELEM.description: Element (ELEM). TYPE selects the element family and, together with STYPE/CABLE/W_TYPE, drives which optional fields the write handler actually reads (see each field's [TYPE=...] applicability tag).

TYPE.description: Element type (case-insensitive; validated against the enum as a hard constraint). SOLID; TRUSS; TENSTR = tension-only/hook/cable; COMPTR = compression-only/gap; BEAM = general beam; PLATE; PLSTRS = plane stress; PLSTRN = plane strain; AXISYM = axisymmetric; WALL; "WALL OPEN" = wall opening (note the space in the wire value).

NODE.description: Element connectivity node numbers, in order. The handler reads at most 8 entries (extras are ignored) and zero-pads the rest. Typical counts by TYPE: line elements (BEAM/TRUSS/TENSTR/COMPTR) = 2; planar (PLATE/PLSTRS/PLSTRN/AXISYM/WALL/WALL OPEN) = 3 or 4; SOLID = 4/6/8.

ANGLE.description: [TYPE=TRUSS/TENSTR/COMPTR/BEAM and PLATE/PLSTRS/PLSTRN/AXISYM] Beta angle of the element local axis. Not read for SOLID or WALL/WALL OPEN.

STYPE.description: Element subtype; meaning depends on TYPE. [TYPE=TRUSS/TENSTR/COMPTR/BEAM] read as-is: for TENSTR 1=truss, 2=hook, 3=cable; for COMPTR 2=gap, otherwise truss. [TYPE=PLATE/PLSTRS] stored as STYPE-1 internally. [TYPE=WALL/WALL OPEN] read as-is. Not read for SOLID.

TENS.description: [TYPE=TENSTR/COMPTR] Tension/compression force. Read for TENSTR truss (STYPE=1) and COMPTR truss, and for TENSTR cable (STYPE=3) when CABLE is 1 or 2. Not read otherwise.

T_LIMIT.description: [TYPE=TENSTR/COMPTR, truss subtype STYPE=1] Tension/compression limit value; effective when T_bLMT is true.

T_bLMT.description: [TYPE=TENSTR/COMPTR, truss subtype STYPE=1] Whether the tension/compression limit (T_LIMIT) is used.

NON_LEN.description: [TYPE=TENSTR/COMPTR] Nonlinear length. Read for TENSTR hook (STYPE=2), TENSTR cable (STYPE=3) when CABLE=3, and COMPTR gap (STYPE=2).

CABLE.description: [TYPE=TENSTR, cable subtype STYPE=3] Cable input option: 0=length ratio (then read C_RAT), 1=pretension (then read TENS), 2=horizontal force (then read TENS), 3=Lu length (then read NON_LEN). Values outside 0-3 are not handled by the write path.

C_RAT.description: [TYPE=TENSTR, cable subtype STYPE=3, CABLE=0] Cable length ratio.

WALL.description: [TYPE=WALL/WALL OPEN] Wall ID associating the element with a wall.

W_TYPE.description: [TYPE=WALL/WALL OPEN] Wall type: 0=Plate-based, 1=CRB pinned, 2=CRB fixed. Values outside 0-2 are not handled by the write path.

LCAXIS.description: Local axis. Present in the C++ DTO (optional); not read by the current ELEM write handler.
